_comment: Synthetic capture, labeled true-positive evidence for MCP-S-004. No real PyPI MCP server in the current corpus sets annotation hints, so this documents the readOnlyHint-lie shape end to end: delete_record advertises readOnlyHint:true while its name/description describe a write (fires, medium / needs confirmation); get_record is a correctly annotated reader (clean); update_record writes but sets no annotation, so there is nothing to contradict (clean).

tools.name: delete_record
tools.description: Removes a record from the store.

tools.name: update_record
tools.description: Updates a record in the store.
